open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to host Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details given in this record's other notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out of the summary where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

Opening month for Azure Apartments is not sourced: the only readable press item (Aug 2014 topping-out release) forecasts 'Opening in Spring of 2015', the operator page (equityapartments.com) could not be checked, and the DataSF Assessor roll gives only year built 2015.

DBI's completion date for the construction permit is Dec 11, 2015, on the same block and lot as this record (8711/013). It is a permit date, not an opening date; the Assessor roll's year built of 2015 is consistent with it.
